_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Rookie's in-match side view from the AI-made run cycle (frame_1..8.png, 1280x720, facing right) and the ready-to-shoot pose (poses.ready: ../side_ready/ready_v1.png). Source px unless noted. See assets/README.md.

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down; die: the gun ends lying level with the fallen body). fists: the near (camera-side) arm's fist centre per source frame; the grip follows it by `follow` from `carry` (px from the feet pivot, source px), so the gun sways with the arm but stays carried. swingDeg: muzzle tilt at the ends of the swing (forward = up).

hand._doc: the fist drawn over the gun's grip, cut from this frame (circle, soft edge)

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

ready._doc: pose px (2048x2048): kneeling, facing right, empty hands. The background is a checkerboard drawn into the pixels with an 'AI' watermark: removed by `background`. scale: source px per pose px (the cap and the face as wide as in the run frames); alignX: the belt buckle on the idle frame's; the knee / boot on the soles' row. The gun is placed by hand in `scene` (one socket per gun kind).

gun._doc: the fallback seat (no scene): the gun's grip in the front fist's hole (pose px), level

hands._doc: the hands drawn over the gun, cut out of the pose (pose px regions) into their own PNGs; the scene places them. patch: what the back hand covered (the front arm it rests on) is filled from a clear column of that arm, along its top edge
